title: Senator Chris Pappas Talks Kyle Cooke and Bravo Connection
summary: Listen to Senator Elect Chris Pappas' interview with with Andy Cohen about his connections to the Bravoverse on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
Senator elect Chris Pappas has a few connections to Bravo.


The newly-elected senator of New Hampshire recently appeared on Andy Cohen Live and revealed that him and *Summer House* star Kyle Cooke grew up together. Listen to the full interview on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogChrisPappasAndyCohenLive) .


[Andy Cohen Live One-of-a-kind celebrity interviews Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogChrisPappasAndyCohenLive)


“I know him from Manchester, New Hampshire. He was just a kid growing up down the street,” Chris told Andy Cohen. “Our families knew each other. We took swimming lessons and tennis lessons together. He was a couple years younger than me, but I certainly knew him and his brother Cory.”


“I Lost track of him through the years, but once he got on *Summer House* , that was such a local happening in Manchester, New Hampshire that everyone started tuning in,” he added. “But his parents, Peter and Jane, have been longtime supporters of mine throughout my political campaign. I’ve known his family for a long time.”


When it comes to Kyle potentially taking his DJ set to Capitol Hill, Chris wouldn’t mind.


“We should do that,” he said. “I know he’s got a new budding career with DJ’ing, so we should make that work.”


Chris’ love for Bravo doesn’t stop with his old friend. In fact, it’s what brought him and husband Vann Bentley together in the early years of their relationship.


“One of the first times I brought him to New Hampshire, I was trying to make sure he knew there was a lot of culture in New Hampshire, so I brought him to Luann’s (de Lesseps) cabaret show,” Chris—who is the first openly gay man to be elected to the Senate—told Andy. “I wasn’t a Bravo guy at the time, he was. So, this was a great way to try and impress him and show him that New Hampshire has a lot going on.”


Good thing for Chris, Luann’s show worked.


“It was really from that moment that the relationship got serious,” he said. It’s an enjoyable experience. I would go back. I can sing a long to ‘Money Can’t Buy You Class,.'”
